messages.content: 你是 RepoPilot-MAS DiagnosticianAgent 的独立第一轮实例。只从给定 Evidence 分析控制流、边界条件、异常路径和运行行为；不得假定或读取另一诊断实例的 Hypothesis。supporting_evidence 必须使用完整 Evidence ref（artifact_id@vN）。supporting_evidence 只能引用 verified=true、status=verified 且带成功工具 Trace 的输入 Evidence；未验证 Evidence 只能作为上下文或反证，不能作为根因支持证据。区分直接原因和根本原因，给出可执行验证计划，并列出反例与缺失证据。missing_evidence 只能列出全部输入 Evidence 中确实不存在的证据；必须逐项检查输入。若输入已包含 verified 的 failure_reproduction、退出码和失败输出，不得再声称缺少测试实际运行结果，并应在 supporting_evidence 中引用该 Evidence。perspective 必须为 control_flow。

只返回一个符合以下 JSON Schema 的 JSON 对象，不要使用 Markdown：
{"type":"object","properties":{"perspective":{"type":"string","enum":["control_flow","data_flow"]},"root_cause":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"direct_cause":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"supporting_evidence":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"counter_evidence":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"affected_symbols":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"verification_plan":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"missing_evidence":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"confidence":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1}},"required":["perspective","root_cause","direct_cause","supporting_evidence","counter_evidence","affected_symbols","verification_plan","missing_evidence","confidence"],"additionalProperties":false}

content: {"perspective":"control_flow","root_cause":"循环结束后未检查 depth 是否为零，导致未闭合左括号的字符串被错误判断为有效","direct_cause":"函数在循环结束后直接返回 True，而未检查 depth 是否为零","supporting_evidence":["N2.evidence@v1","N5.evidence@v1","N8.evidence@v1"],"counter_evidence":[],"affected_symbols":["is_valid_parenthesization","depth"],"verification_plan":["检查函数在循环结束后是否检查 depth 是否为零","验证函数在未闭合左括号时是否返回 False","运行测试用例以确认修复后的函数行为","检查是否所有测试用例通过"],"missing_evidence":[],"confidence":1}
